answer: Run summit-relic forfeiture: at each close, a shard's most-attesting identity over six epochs (the summit) stakes a relic - 5% of the next three epoch payouts it would receive. If audit later finds over 30% of the shard's rows failed, the relic burns into the public dune registry and the summit's attestation weight resets to zero for two epochs. Sybil volume can't buy the seat: attestations are per-identity and rate-limited, so only a real high-volume attester with earned emission to forfeit can hold it. Every padded row raises the rental price of the summit a cluster is paying to hold.
